Check / Check Out time is 11.00 am.
A Day care patient will be admitted and discharged the same tay

If 19 Day care patient is not discharged the same day, he / the will have to be transferred to a ward The patient will have  to select a bed class, and will be charged as per the selected class, from the date and time of admission.

in case of A foreign national patient admission, the patient should mandatorily mention / disclose the same and  accordingly submit proof thereof (Le. passport and valid visa), at the time of admission
There IS no surcharge on the hospital bill, however all foreign nationals and NRIs will be levied 25% administrative  charges on the gross bill
Except for the Pharmacy, Materials and Consumables, all the other charges may differ, as per their respective class

in case a cashless facility is availed of with an attached TPA / Insurance Company, the patient will need to submit  the policy copy, photo ID (self), 3 duly filled Pre-Authorization Form and other related documents, to the Billing  department atleast 4 to 5 days prior to the expected date of admission.
